title: Benchmark verdict: orch-ON vs OFF — context-rich
summary: Model=opus, n=3 trials/arm, headless A/B. gross OFF = 352,877 ± 744 tok; gross ON = 343,232 ± 31,068 tok. TOTAL overhead (gross ON − OFF) = −9,645 tok (−2.7%) — ON ran slightly CHEAPER, within ON's 9% variance. Plumbing = 0 on every ON run (opus called no orchestrator tools on the self-contained spec), so NET ≡ GROSS; net work did NOT drop. The available prior context appears to offset the MCP schema tax: orchestrator availability is cost-neutral-to-mildly-positive on a context-rich problem. 0 dropped, 0 contaminated.
